verdict.rationale: Turso provides branching (versioning of schema/data changes, including automating a new branch per PR) and point-in-time recovery (rollback for user errors), and its MCP integration lets an AI agent create/manage these branches and run SQL directly. However, there is no documented 'review' mechanism (e.g., diffing or approval workflow before merging a branch back), so the story's review component is unevidenced. Missing for 10: explicit review/diff/approval tooling for automation changes, and independent confirmation that AI agents actually use branching+PITR as a version-control workflow in practice.
